title: Union bound for layer-2 CNF replaceability
statement:
Let $g_1,\dots,g_{s_2}$ be a family of DNF formulas in $n$ variables, and suppose $n \ge 1$. Fix a width bound $w \ge 1$ and assume each $g_i$ has width at most $w$; assume moreover that within every term of every $g_i$ the literals are pairwise distinct and any two literals on the same variable coincide, so that no variable occurs more than once in a term. Let $p \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 < p \le \frac{1}{40w}$ and $p \le 1$, and draw a random restriction $\rho$ on the $n$ variables from the Bernoulli($p$) distribution, in which each variable is independently left free with probability $p$ and otherwise fixed to $0$ or $1$ each with probability $\frac{1-p}{2}$. Then the probability that some gate $g_i$ fails to be representable after restriction — that is, that there is an index $i$ for which the restricted function $g_i\!\restriction_\rho$ (the value $x \mapsto g_i(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$) is not computed by any CNF formula of width at most $l$ — is at most
\[
  s_2 \cdot \left( \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{l} + \exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n p}{3}\right) \right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: a family of $s_2$ DNF gates in $n$ variables
each gate has width at most $w$
in each term, literals sharing a variable are identical
each term has no repeated literal (no duplicates)
replaced:
Let $\mathrm{gates}_0,\dots,\mathrm{gates}_{s_2-1}$ be the layer-2 $\mathrm{DNF}$ gates, each of
width at most $w>0$ (with distinct variables per term and no duplicate literals), let $n>0$,
and let $0<p\le \tfrac{1}{40w}$ with $p\le 1$. Then the probability under a Bernoulli$(p)$
restriction $\rho$ that some gate fails to admit a width-$l$ $\mathrm{CNF}$ representation of
$\mathrm{gates}_i|_\rho$ is at most
\[
  s_2\cdot\Bigl(\Bigl(\tfrac12\Bigr)^l + \exp\!\Bigl(-\tfrac{np}{3}\Bigr)\Bigr).
\]
